content.text:
The primary capability-only flow works and passes focused validation, but late host identity can race an in-flight capability-backed state save and break subsequent persistence.

Review comment:

- [P2] Serialize late host binding with capability-backed saves — /Users/burakemre/Code/lobu/.claude/worktrees/mcp-app-v8/packages/owletto/src/mcp-apps/_shared/host.tsx:341-341
  When `toolInfo` arrives while a capability-only `setViewState` save is still in flight, this starts an ID-binding `save_lobu_app_state` concurrently. If the ID-binding request commits first, the older capability-only request can move the snapshot back to the capability key while the successful binding clears `snapshotCapability.current`; later ID-only saves then target a missing row and silently stop persisting view state. Serialize these save paths, or preserve already-bound keys before clearing the capability.
